text.title: Business Model Planning Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the buyer's job is stated with a circumstance, whether an incumbent category exists to plot a strategy canvas against, and whether the free path carries metered per-user cost — to full application, the VPC or pricing half alone, or a halt on the customer profile.

decision-tree.root-question: Can the buyer's job be written as verb plus object plus circumstance, and is there an established category with incumbents whose offer can be plotted?

branch.when: the buyer is described only by role, industry or demographic ('freelancers in Portugal', 'SMB marketers') with no circumstance attached

conclusion.verdict: halt; a role label is served identically by every competitor in the category, so nothing downstream discriminates — observe or interview until the job and its circumstance are stated, then re-enter

branch.when: jobs are stated with circumstance and an established category of incumbents exists to plot against
branch.question: Does the intended free or entry path call metered infrastructure — model inference, per-request APIs, per-user storage — for each non-paying user?

branch.when: yes; each free user carries real per-request COGS

conclusion.verdict: apply, and freemium may enter `pricing_model` only once the marginal cost per free user is stated and either shown near zero or capped by a hard usage limit

branch.when: no; marginal cost per free user is near zero, or no free path is planned

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; the Four Actions grid must carry entries under both eliminate and create, both canvas curves share one identically ordered factor axis, and every unchosen pricing model gets a named rejection reason

branch.when: no incumbent category to plot against — the alternative buyers actually use is a spreadsheet, a person, or doing nothing
branch.question: Is the open question the shape of the offer, or the pricing model over an offer already fixed?

branch.when: the offer shape is what is unsettled

conclusion.verdict: apply the Value Proposition Canvas half only; every pain reliever and gain creator cites a profile id, and the strategy canvas is dropped — there is no incumbent curve to diverge from

branch.when: the offer is fixed and only the charging model is open

conclusion.verdict: apply the pricing half; name the unit charged, show it rising as delivered value rises, and record a rejection reason for every model in the enum that was not selected
